cue: A crawl or check is made exhaustive (every button in every state) before it is timed.
lesson: Time the check on the real tree before widening it, and choose the unit it repeats on (here the view type) by what the time limit allows.
evidence: aip-31df: pressing every button in every state took 361 to 623 s against c4's 300 s; per view type (d-5afb) it took 42 s, and checking every state while pressing buttons per view type took 94 to 101 s.
